schema.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

en.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

en.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
en.#I prepare differently or change route (: I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
en.#I put off or skip some trips: I put off or skip some trips
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

it.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Quando vai in moto o in scooter, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)

fr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)

de.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Was tun Sie beim Motorrad- oder Rollerfahren normalerweise, wenn das Wetter schlecht ist (Regen, Wind, Kälte oder große Hitze)?
de.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Nichts ändert sich, ich bin wie gewohnt unterwegs
de.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Es ist weniger angenehm, aber ich bin auf dieselbe Weise unterwegs
de.#I prepare differently or change route (: Ich bereite mich anders vor oder ändere die Route (z. B. Kleidung, Regenschirm)
de.#I put off or skip some trips: Ich verschiebe oder streiche manche Wege
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Auto oder Bus)

tr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Motosiklet veya scooter sürerken hava koşulları kötü olduğunda (yağmur, rüzgâr, soğuk veya aşırı sıcak) genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Hiçbir şey değişmez, her zamanki gibi yolculuk ederim
tr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Daha az keyifli ama aynı şekilde yolculuk ederim
tr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Farklı hazırlanırım veya güzergâhı değiştiririm (örn. kıyafet, şemsiye)
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otomobille veya otobüsle)

fa.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: هنگام موتورسواری، وقتی هوا بد است (باران، باد، سرما یا گرمای شدید) معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: چیزی تغییر نمی‌کند، مثل همیشه سفر می‌کنم
fa.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: کمتر دلپذیر است، اما به همان شکل سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I prepare differently or change route (: طور دیگری آماده می‌شوم یا مسیرم را عوض می‌کنم (مثلاً لباس، چتر)
fa.#I put off or skip some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو یا اتوبوس)

hu.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Motorozás vagy robogózás közben mit szokott tenni, ha rossz az idő (eső, szél, hideg vagy nagy hőség)?
hu.#I prepare differently or change route (: Másképp készülök, vagy útvonalat váltok (pl. ruházat, esernyő)
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Más módon utazom (pl. autóval vagy busszal)

ar.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: عند ركوب الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر، ما تصرّفك عادةً عندما يكون الطقس سيئًا (مطر أو رياح أو برد أو حرّ شديد)؟
ar.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: الأمر أقل متعة، لكنني أتنقل بالطريقة نفسها
ar.#I prepare differently or change route (: أستعد بشكل مختلف أو أغيّر طريقي (مثل الملابس أو المظلة)
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالسيارة أو الحافلة)
